name: Malek Ashtar University of Technology
aliases: MALEK ASHTAR UNIVERSITY OF DEFENSE TECHNOLOGY
Malek Ashtar University of Defense Technology
supervisors: Ministry of Defense and Armed Forces Logistics (MODAFL)

evidence.summary: The UN Security Council listed Malek Ashtar University in resolution 1929 (2010) as a subordinate of the Defense Technology and Science Research Center within Iran’s Ministry of Defense and Armed Forces Logistics (MODAFL), including research groups that had belonged to the Physics Research Center. OFAC lists it as Malek Ashtar University of Technology, in Tehran, under its weapons-of-mass-destruction proliferators programme.
It belongs to Iran’s Ministry of Defense and Armed Forces Logistics (MODAFL), through the Defense Technology and Science Research Center.

sources.title: Resolution 1929 (2010), adopted by the Security Council on 9 June 2010 (S/RES/1929 (2010)), Annex I
